body: A water bottle and tin opener sit tagged with numbered paper tied by string. A pen mark tracks the bottle's level, and barrier tape circles the opener's handle. Each tag lists an evacuation zone but leaves the recipient line unfilled.
title: Awaiting assignment

body: One bowl is clean and tied to a second with string. The count scratched into the first was reduced in pencil on the other, though both were carried to the table.
title: The unserved bowl
